title: Patch: Starships built from what they hold: every Starship Piece drawn on the hull as itself, hull designs of their own, and a dormant ship in a shipyard
notes: Part of #3330's Stinkyscape art. Every Starship Piece, the 47 cards that print it and Stinkyscape #127 to #129 when Embiggened, has a module of its own, a part drawn where it mounts on a hull: the Beams, Repeaters, Cannons, Flak and Mining Drills bigger and busier each tier, the defenses, engines, launchers (each loaded with what it fires), pods (the Felinor Containment Chamber a cat at its porthole) and the odd ones each their own (R3333001). A piece's own card draws its module large on a cutaway of a hull in a bay by its family, and its fifty pictures are recorded again (R503). A Starship in play is the ship its pieces build, oldest first: each module on its hardpoint (the bow for weapons, the spine for defenses, the flanks for launchers and pods, the stern for engines, the keel for miners), a running light along the keel for each, its hull growing from a frigate to a dreadnought with its count; launched, it wears the hull design of the name it took, each of the seven its own prow, windows, livery and emblem; Dormant, it sits in a shipyard, welding sparks where its newest piece went in and a dock lamp brightening as it fills. A design and a livery are the painter's inputs, for #3330's cosmetic track (R3333000). A Dormant hull's plates and the pieces list show each piece's module icon (R3333002). No base face wears Radiant's gold (R2725004). How cards look only: nothing plays differently.

player.title: Starships built from what they hold
changes: A Starship is now drawn from the pieces fused into it: weapons on its bow, engines at its stern, drills under its keel, pods and launchers along its sides.
The more pieces a Starship holds, the bigger its hull, from a frigate to a dreadnought.
Each of the seven names a Starship can launch under has its own hull: The Ninth Life has whiskers and portholes, The Lantern Ferry a lantern on its bow, The Silent Choir organ pipes, and so on.
A Dormant Starship is drawn in a shipyard, sparks flying where its newest piece went in.
Every Starship Piece's card shows its part large, in a bay of its own, and a Cannon v5 or a Mining Drill v5 is clearly bigger than the tiers below it.
A Dormant Starship's hull plates and its list of pieces show a small picture of each piece's part.
